prompt: Write a Playwright script that tests a local todo application. The app should be running on http://localhost:5173. Your script must: (1) navigate to the app and wait for it to fully load, (2) take a screenshot of the initial state and save it as 'initial_state.png', (3) add three todo items with the text 'Buy groceries', 'Write report', and 'Call dentist', (4) verify each item appears in the DOM after adding, (5) mark the second item as complete by clicking its checkbox, (6) take a final screenshot showing the completed state and save it as 'final_state.png', (7) output a JSON file named 'test_results.json' containing an object with keys 'total_items' (number 3), 'completed_items' (number 1), and 'screenshots_taken' (number 2). Save your script as 'test_todo_app.py' in the current directory.
